cd "C:/Users/ryanf/AppData/Local/Temp/pixl-host-trial-yiugusfw" && "C:/Users/ryanf/github/pixel-lab-docsuite/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" -c "
from PIL import Image
c=Image.open('candidate.png').convert('RGBA'); r=Image.open('reference.png').convert('RGBA')
def feat(im,name):
    w,h=im.size; px=im.load()
    eye=[(x,y) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if px[x,y][:3]==(0xF4,0xDD,0xA2) and px[x,y][3]]
    print(name,'eye pixels',len(eye))
    if eye:
        xs=[p[0] for p in eye]; ys=[p[1] for p in eye]
        cols=sorted(set(xs)); print('  eye x-range',min(xs),max(xs),'y-range',min(ys),max(ys),'x cols',cols)
    # top band rows 3..8 opaque columns
    for y in range(3,10):
        cols=[x for x in range(w) if px[x,y][3]]
        print('  row',y,'opaque cols',cols)
feat(r,'reference'); feat(c,'candidate')
diff=[(x,y) for y in range(32) for x in range(32) if c.load()[x,y]!=r.load()[x,y]]
print('differing pixels',len(diff))
xs=[p[0] for p in diff]; ys=[p[1] for p in diff]
print('diff bbox',min(xs),min(ys),max(xs),max(ys))
"
